posts.text: As chairman of @HomelandGOP's Special Events Task Force, I will continue doing everything in my power to ensure the World Cup games are fun and safe for everyone involved. Our next order of business must be funding CBP and ICE — including ICE's crucial Homeland Security Investigations office, which leads essential anti-human trafficking efforts at large-scale sporting events.

I strongly applaud the passage of today’s DHS funding bill, which is critical for closing security gaps ahead of our upcoming FIFA World Cup games. Despite Democrats' attempts to play political games with ICE and CBP, I am also glad this bill funded CBP's National Targeting Center, which works to identify and stop travelers and cargo that pose a threat to our nation. With only 42 days left until kickoff, DHS must be operating at peak capacity.

After sitting back-to-back with @SandraSmithFox at the White House Correspondents' Dinner, I joined her on @AmericaRpts to discuss the aftermath of the shooting and my thoughts on the venue's security.

With only 44 days until the first @FIFAWorldCup game, we must do everything in our power to secure the airspace over our 11 host cities. While the Safer Skies Act was a vital step forward, the tournament’s scale requires us to build upon that foundation immediately. reuters.com/world/us/congres…
Tune in now 🚨 I’m joining @AmericaRpts live on Fox News to discuss the harrowing shooting at the White House Correspondents’ dinner and what lessons can be learned about security at major events.

Last night's shooting at the White House Correspondents' Dinner was another reminder that we must work together to lower the temperature and end political violence. I joined @BloombergTV to share my thoughts and describe the scene after shots rang out.

I was at the White House Correspondents' Dinner this evening when shots were fired. Thanks to the swift response of Secret Service and @Capitolpolice, who escorted me from the premises, my congressional colleagues and I are safe. I’m incredibly grateful for their quick actions to protect all in attendance — including President Trump.

Today, I stood in front of 20,000 teddy bears on the national mall — each one representing an abducted Ukrainian child — to condemn Putin's brutality and remind the world of these children's plight.

Many of them are tortured, forced to memorize propaganda, and/or sent to the front lines to fight against their own country.

This is evil in its purest form. Now is the time for moral clarity, and history will judge us by how we respond.
